findings.claim: 2026 review: growing graft demand, wider transplant criteria and rising organ disease leave a global shortage of transplantable grafts; US waitlist >104,000 in late 2024, ~7,000 die yearly before receiving an organ (shortage framed as persistent/structural)
TMDX reported 5,139 U.S. OCS cases in FY2025, +38% vs 3,735 in FY2024; Q2 2026 revenue +20.7% YoY to $189.9M and low end of 2026 guidance raised to $737-757M (ex-PAD)
findings.source: TransMedics 8-K / Q4 2025 and Q2 2026 results (via search summaries)
findings.excerpt: Second-quarter 2026 revenues rose 20.7% year over year to $189.9 million.

findings.claim: Management reaffirmed ~10,000 transplants/yr by 2028 on current heart/lung/liver platform (ex kidney); kidney and international drive 10,000->20,000 by 2030-2032; 2028 target $1.2B revenue and 30% op margin
findings.excerpt: Reaffirmed ~10,000 transplants by 2028 on the current heart/lung/liver platform (excluding CHOPS and kidney); kidney and international drive 10,000->20,000 by 2030-2032.

findings.claim: 2026 adjusted operating margin outlook cut to 12.5%-14% from ~16% mainly due to accelerated OCS Kidney investment; commentary frames it as capex/execution story
findings.excerpt: Management reduced its 2026 adjusted operating-margin outlook, excluding PAD Aviation, to 12.5%-14% from about 16%, mainly because of accelerated OCS Kidney investment.

findings.claim: Visible Alpha consensus (S&P Global, Apr 2026): OCS Heart revenue ~$157M in 2026 (+25%), US heart volumes 909 (2025) to 1,124; US OCS Lung volumes nearly doubling to 194
findings.source: S&P Global Market Intelligence: TransMedics clinical pipeline to drive next phase of growth
findings.excerpt: Visible Alpha consensus points to OCS Heart revenues reaching $157 million in 2026, an increase of 25% year-on-year, supported by US unit volumes rising to 1,124 from 909 in 2025.

findings.claim: Competition/consolidation: Terumo acquired OrganOx for $1.5B (Aug 2025) per a single low-quality market report; no concrete 2026-27 competitor capacity announcements found

supply_demand_durability.note: No credible cyclical-vs-structural forecast for 2027-28 US transplant volumes found; no independent 2027/2028 analyst consensus found. Competitor capacity timeline none. Terumo/OrganOx claim from single weak source, unverified.
